main_text.p: ctione[?], in matulâ vitreâ, pellucidâ, albâ, tenui. colligenda inquam, non post crapulam, aut assumptione medicamentorum eam tingentium, aut alio modo afficientium: nec tamen diu servanda, quæ ultra quinque aut sex horas servatur corrumpitur, & putrescit;adeò ut nihil significet. Vbi verò aliquandiu resederit,& refrixerit,inspicienda erit;non tamen in radiis solaribus, sed extra eos in aëre lucido.

In uriua sex considerant Medici, consistentiam, seu modum substantiæ, perspicuitatem, quantitatem, odorem, colorem, & [illegible, ~8 letters] contenta; quæ singula consideranda sunt seorsum. Si modus substantiæ consideretur; urina alia crassa, alia tenuis, alia mediocris. Urina interdum transparens, interdum obscura & opaca, ut eam permeare nequeat visus. Ratione quantitatis, vel multa, vel pauca, ac proinde interdum respondet potui, interdum non. Odor urinæ propriè nullus est; aut si est, fœtidus est; nisi forsan medica-

page.notes: The word "danique" after "&" is overprinted by a handwritten mark and is not legible; the phrase is given as illegible. The first word of the page is partly obscured, so "ctione" is doubtful. "uriua" is printed as shown and may be a misprint for "urina". The line "medica-" is hyphenated at the foot and runs on to the next page. No catchword or signature is visible.
